subject: Apply Lisa to AcmeOrgD and migrate project-specific mocks
description:
Run bun run dev on AcmeOrgD, then migrate project-specific mocks to jest.setup.local.ts and jest.setup.pre.local.js. Remove setupFiles from jest.config.local.ts.

**Verification:** `cd /Users/cody/workspace/acmeorgd/frontend && bun run test`

learnings: AcmeOrgD had pre-existing lint error (functional/immutable-data) in jest.setup.ts reanimated mock - fixed with spread pattern
AcmeOrgD needed components/ui added to tsconfig.expo.json exclude manually since prior Lisa run didn't include it
